title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu fumes with anger as Mathangi reveals that Kanmani remains undecided about her pregnancy. Sivagami and Pavithra warmly welcome Kanmani home with traditional rituals.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi stops Paraman from collecting rent for Kalamma, while Paraman shows kindness, surprising Kalamma. Later, Karthi hurts a borrower and gives her a seized bangle.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri enjoys a joyful moment with Sudar, Diya and Tarun. Meanwhile, Swetha refuses to marry until Abinaya is jailed, while Karna vows to put her behind bars again.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Deivanai deliberately creates a mess in the kitchen and falsely blames Poongodi, provoking Meenatchi. Pechi warns Deivanai for turning the family against Poongodi.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Driven by suspicion over Revathi's chats, Thangaraj searches her phone but fails due to her password change. Ragavan refuses to buy Lakshmi walking shoes, but she remains firm.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Meena and Raji caution Gomathi about Saravanan's anger at Thangamayil's stay. Later, Saravanan's excitement over Anjali keeps Kathir and Senthil from revealing the truth.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: After hearing everyone's explanation, Chandayatha decides to leave Cheran. However, their true love brings them back together, leading to a joyful and emotional reunion.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Rohini Hopes to Reunite with Manoj
description: After winning the court's favour, Rohini unveils her plan to use her child to win Manoj back. Meanwhile, Muthu and Meena convince Nachiyar to let Rohini stay with them.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam gives Tamizhselvi her share of the monetary gifts received during the ceremony. She accepts it, easing her family's concern as it helps redeem her mortgaged car.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karthik's arrival at the restaurant leaves Aadhavan tense as he spends time with Pooja. A suspicious person repeatedly honks outside Madhu's house, disturbing her family.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira fixes a UPI machine and wins Lakshmi's approval to get her bike. Returning to work for incentives, she disguises herself and picks up Kandhasamy, leaving Murugan stunned.
